sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Gastric headache. Broad, flabby tongue; foul
breath. Haemorrhoids and constipation.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Must wait for minute before flow starts then
first in drops.

4 Extremities. — Rheumatism of muscles and joints,
with obstinate constipation.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare; Hyd,; Nux.; Rhamnus
Calif ornica (tincture for constipation; tympanites and
appendicitis and especially rheumatism).

ENwe. --- Fiist to sixth potency.
